title: Exact bit complexity of the variable-dimension tilt-DP dual
statement: Determine whether min_beta v_K(S_psi-beta S_lambda), with K and d_lambda part of the rational input, admits exact algebraic optimization in polynomial bit complexity using the fixed-tilt interval-DP oracle, including active tie refinements, without materializing a potentially large parametric-DP envelope. Fixed-tilt exact evaluation, polynomial certified-epsilon minimization, and exact fixed-(K,d_lambda) computation are already settled by DS-TILT-DUAL-CERTIFICATE.
assumptions: positive rational weights; exact-K nonempty cells; rational score table
exact means an algebraic optimizer/value with checkable comparisons, not a crossings grid or epsilon approximation
common empirical nuisance-null directions may be quotiented before optimization

proof_location.section: OP31. Exact bit complexity of the tilt-DP dual

warning: General parametric-shortest-path envelope lower bounds do not automatically transfer to the special scalar grouping DP. A valid hardness reduction or a structure-exploiting exact algorithm is required.
